messages:
anya: Hey team — Sales asked for a formal playbook we can hand to large customers who want model pinning + guaranteed migration windows. They want SLA-style language around compatibility and a clear onboarding checklist. Can we draft a short playbook in this thread? Need: acceptance tests, benchmark thresholds, pin TTL options, rollback gates, comm windows.

sam: +1. Two tracks makes sense: 'strict pin' (customer-controlled, no auto rollforward) and 'soft pin' (auto-migrate after a grace period with opt-out).

miguel: For benchmarks we should require three signals: perf (latency), quality (automated metrics + sampling), and safety/regression checks. Minimal thresholds to start: latency p95 <= 200ms for short requests, quality delta <= 1% measured on customer golden set, safety no new high-severity flags.

helen: From CS/Legal: customers will ask for >=90 days migration notice and an option for paid migration assistance. Also need a comms template they can copy.

raj: Infra note: strict pins imply reserved capacity or Dedicated offering. For Hosted, strict pins need a technical guarantee path (e.g., preserve exact model artifact + quantization profile). Also need auto-fallback policy if a pinned model is later found to be insecure.

anya: Can we make the thresholds concrete and runnable? Proposal: latency p95 <= 200ms for <=1024 tokens; embedding cosine drop <= 0.02 on golden set; sample suite pass rate >= 95%. Pin TTL options: `pin_ttl_days: 90` OR `pin_ttl_days: 365` for enterprise.

miguel: Embedding delta is implementation-specific — recommend we require a per-customer golden prompt set. Metric: mean cosine(sim_old, sim_new) >= 0.92 and median difference <= 0.01. We should include exact eval script.

sam: Rollout plan suggestion: canary -> small cohort -> broad rollout. Example canary config:
```yaml
canary:
  cohorts: [1%, 10%, 50%]
  interval_days: [1, 3, 3]
  abort_on_quality_drop_pct: 1.0
```
Auto-abort if quality regressions exceed threshold or error rate spikes.

helen: Comms checklist: announcement email, migration FAQ, opt-in link, rollback policy, support contact, compensation clause. Add standard wording for SLA credits.

deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-6843 - model-pinning-playbook-draft (assigned to anya).

raj: For Private deployments we need an ops-runbook section: how to pin model artifacts, how to restore KV cache compatibility, db schema migration notes, and HSM/KMS handling for keys.

helen: Also define refund/credit policy clearly for migrations that cause >30m outage or data regressions. Legal wants thresholds spelled out.

sam: I'll prototype the canary gating script and provide a small CLI to run the three evals against a pre/post snapshot. Will need the golden prompts from Miguel.

anya: Draft owners and deadlines:
- Spec doc + SLA language: anya (draft by EOD Fri)
- Benchmark harness + golden prompts: miguel (PR by next Wed)
- Canary gating script + infra knobs: sam (initial patch next Tue)
- Sales/legal comm templates + refund policy: helen (draft by Mon)
- Dedicated/private ops runbook: raj (outline by Thu)

anya: Action items consolidated. Let's do a short sync Mon 10:00am to review. :calendar:

helen: Acked. I'll pull previous SLA templates and paste a starter.

miguel: I'll upload an example golden prompts tarball to the ticket and include eval instructions.

sam: ping me when the prompts are in PROD-6843, I'll wire the test runner.

anya: Thanks everyone — goal is a customer-facing 1-pager + internal runbook. Keeping the playbook lean so Sales can hand it to customers during negotiations.
